message.content: In the discussion, Ileana mentions a specific quest in Witcher 3 where she felt torn about her choices due to the severe consequences they could have. She elaborates, "It’s like you want to help him, but at the same time, his past and choices make it really complicated. I ended up feeling guilty no matter what path I took." This indicates that the quest in question involves the Bloody Baron, a character whose personal struggles and choices significantly impact Geralt and the world around him, drawing the player into a complex moral dilemma.
